passage.text: I took the day off work and went to the book fair with Fah, because I wanted to buy Kanya Siriwong's new novel.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈtʊk ðə ˈdeɪ ˈɔːf ˈwɜːrk ənd ˈwɛnt tə ðə ˈbʊk ˌfɛr wɪð ˈfɑː, bɪˈkɔːz aɪ ˈwɑːntɪd tə ˈbaɪ ˈkɑːnjə ˈsɪriwɔːŋz ˈnuː ˈnɑːvəl.

passage.text: When we got to her publisher's stall, a woman told us that Kanya was going to have a book signing at two o'clock!
passage.reading: wɛn wiː ˈɡɑːt tə hɜːr ˈpʌblɪʃərz ˈstɔːl, ə ˈwʊmən ˈtoʊld ʌs ðæt ˈkɑːnjə wʌz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈhæv ə ˈbʊk ˌsaɪnɪŋ ət ˈtuː əˈklɑːk!

passage.text: I couldn't believe it, so we waited in line for almost three hours.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈkʊdənt bɪˈliːv ɪt, soʊ wiː ˈweɪtɪd ɪn ˈlaɪn fər ˈɔːlmoʊst ˈθriː ˈaʊərz.

passage.text: Fah complained that her feet hurt, but I didn't mind.
passage.reading: ˈfɑː kəmˈpleɪnd ðæt hɜːr ˈfiːt ˈhɜːrt, bʌt aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈmaɪnd.

passage.text: Finally, it was my turn, and my hands were shaking.
passage.reading: ˈfaɪnəli, ɪt wʌz maɪ ˈtɜːrn, ənd maɪ ˈhændz wɜːr ˈʃeɪkɪŋ.

passage.text: Kanya asked my name and wrote "To Nam, never stop reading!" in my book.
passage.reading: ˈkɑːnjə ˈæskt maɪ ˈneɪm ənd ˈroʊt tə ˈnɑːm, ˈnɛvər ˈstɑːp ˈriːdɪŋ! ɪn maɪ ˈbʊk.

passage.text: I told her that her novels had inspired me to write my own stories.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈtoʊld hɜːr ðæt hɜːr ˈnɑːvəlz hæd ɪnˈspaɪərd miː tə ˈraɪt maɪ ˈoʊn ˈstɔːriz.

passage.text: She said that I should keep writing and never give up.
passage.reading: ʃiː ˈsɛd ðæt aɪ ʃʊd ˈkiːp ˈraɪtɪŋ ənd ˈnɛvər ˈɡɪv ˈʌp.

passage.text: Fah took a photo of us together, and I posted it on social media.
passage.reading: ˈfɑː ˈtʊk ə ˈfoʊtoʊ əv ʌs təˈɡɛðər, ənd aɪ ˈpoʊstɪd ɪt ɑːn ˈsoʊʃəl ˈmiːdiə.

passage.text: It already has two hundred likes!
passage.reading: ɪt ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈhæz ˈtuː ˈhʌndrəd ˈlaɪks!

passage.text: Now I have her autograph, a photo and a new favorite day.
passage.reading: ˈnaʊ aɪ ˈhæv hɜːr ˈɔːtəɡræf, ə ˈfoʊtoʊ ənd ə ˈnuː ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈdeɪ.
